t: Router set containing a range of the most widely used cutters for decorative woodworking including ¼" shank cutters suitable for grooving, profiling and moulding. Suitable for use on softwoods, hardwoods, MDF and plywood. Compatible with most major power tool brands. Supplied with carry case.
b: Suitable for Cutting Softwood, Hardwood, Laminate, Veneer Wood, Plywood, Chipboard, Fibreboard & Sandwich Material
